era: 20世纪存在主义与女性主义理论时代 / Twentieth-Century Existentialist & Feminist-Theory Era (1908-1986)
school: 存在主义伦理学/女性主义理论 / Existentialist Ethics / Feminist Theory
historical_significance: 现代女性主义理论奠基人。《第二性》以'女人不是天生的，而是被塑造成的'一句改写了性别研究的基本框架——将'女性'从生物事实重构为社会建构的处境。她把存在主义哲学（自由、处境、他者、超越性/内在性）系统运用于女性经验分析，使哲学从抽象主体走向具体的、有身体的、被处境规定的生存者。其'境况性自由'理论既是存在主义伦理学的完成，也是后世社会建构论、交叉性理论的直接源头。
unique_thinking: 以处境分析为入口、以自由/超越性为核心价值、以他者化为关键机制、以模糊性为方法论自觉的四层体系。其思维特质在于：拒绝一切本质主义（无论颂扬还是贬抑女性'天性'），坚持'生存者是在处境中被把握的'——自由从来不是悬空的抽象选择，而是始终在历史、身体、经济与符号条件中的突围。

cross_references.relation_type: 主奴辩证法的性别化改写：他者化机器的哲学母本
cross_references.description_zh: 波伏娃对黑格尔主奴辩证法做了双重改造：其一，指出主奴关系以双方自由为前提——奴隶通过劳动面向未来，而女性他者化之所以更稳固，恰因女性'分散栖居'于男性之中、不构成独立共同体，无法复制奴隶的斗争路径；其二，黑格尔的他者是斗争的产物，波伏娃的他者是一部被制造的机器——有范畴起源（谁划分、谁受益）、绝对主体位置与报酬结构。从 M-HEG-002/005 到 M-BV-002/003，是异化理论最成功的性别化重写。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 黑格尔档案（H-HEG-001）未来修订时可在'主奴辩证法'处补一条指向 H-BV-001 的跨引用（他者概念的性别化重写）。

cross_references.relation_type: 主体尊严的两条路线：先验担保 vs 无担保行动
cross_references.description_zh: 康德与波伏娃共享'人是目的而非手段'的主体尊严前提，但路线相反：康德以先验律令为道德行动提供最终担保，波伏娃在《模糊性的道德》中宣告一切担保的失败——无神意、无历史必然性，伦理学的任务是为无担保行动建立责任结构而非假装担保存在（M-KD-003/007 × M-BV-006）。一个以普遍立法锁定义务，一个以模糊性解放行动；两者对照标定'道德哲学能否离开担保'的分水岭。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 康德档案（H-KD-001）未来修订时可在'定言命令'处补一条指向 H-BV-001 的跨引用（无担保行动伦理对先验担保的替代）。

cross_references.relation_type: 身体哲学的接力：身体现象学 vs 身体处境化
cross_references.description_zh: 梅洛-庞蒂把身体确立为'在世界中存在'的媒介（body-subject），波伏娃在《第二性》'生物学论据'章把这一现象学洞见转用于性别分析：身体不是物而是处境，其意义由使用方式而非解剖学给定（M-MV-003 × M-BV-005）。梅洛-庞蒂提供了'身体即媒介'的一般框架，波伏娃补上关键一步——身体意义的历史与权力分配：同一生理事件在不同处境中是从容、负担或羞辱。现象学由此走向性别政治。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 梅洛-庞蒂档案（H-MV-001）未来修订时可在'身体图式'处补一条指向 H-BV-001 的跨引用（身体媒介的处境化与政治化）。

cross_references.relation_type: 无担保处境的两种回应：荒诞的清醒 vs 模糊性的行动
cross_references.description_zh: 加缪与波伏娃面对同一个无担保处境（无神、无历史必然性），给出两条路径：加缪停在荒诞的清醒——承认荒诞、反抗但不指望意义（M-ASM-003）；波伏娃走向模糊性的行动——把模糊性从障碍改写为运作条件，为没有最终担保的行动建立伦理与失败的责任结构（M-BV-006）。一个以保持清醒为诚实的上限，一个以承担责任为诚实的下限；两者共同划定了存在主义伦理学内部'清醒'与'介入'的分界。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 加缪档案（H-ASM-001）未来修订时可在'荒诞与反抗'处补一条指向 H-BV-001 的跨引用（同一无担保处境的行动化版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 传记作为知识生产的两个方向：为他者立传 vs 以己为样本
cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁以列传为他者立传，把人物放进处境与制度中解释成败（M-SMQ-321 '读其书而考其行'）；波伏娃以四部曲自传把自己放上解剖台——'我'作为受控样本而非主角，双向解剖处境如何塑造自我、自我如何利用处境（M-BV-009）。两人在'以传记做知识生产'上同构：司马迁向外部世界取样，波伏娃向自身取样并显式声明样本身份；两部工作共同确立了'处境化传记'的中国与法国原型。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 司马迁档案（H-SMQ-001）未来修订时可在'究天人之际'处补一条指向 H-BV-001 的跨引用（传记知识生产的自我样本化方向）。

caveats: 波伏娃生卒年（1908-1986）无争议；但《第二性》1949年初版与后来英文译本（1953 Parshley 译本大量删节，2010 重新全译）差异显著，引用须注明所据版本
'女人不是天生的，而是后天形成的'常被截断引用为'女人不是天生的'——原句的重点在后半的生成过程，引用须保全完整句
波伏娃与萨特的关系协定在早期叙述中被'担保豁免'（描述为超越处境），后世旁证（比安卡·朗布林、纳尔逊·奥尔格伦书信等）显示叙述经过利益重构，使用其自传材料须做双向校正

波伏娃对苏联劳动营的长期沉默与其模糊性伦理存在张力，评价其政治介入须同时记账'不行动的后果'
波伏娃对第二波女性主义内部阶级与种族分歧处理迟缓，其框架以法国白人中产女性为默认样本，用于其他语境须做交叉性校正

modes.name_en: The Situated-Freedom Method: No Free Will Outside a Situation
modes.domain_zh: 存在主义伦理学/处境分析
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃的元命题：自由从来不是真空中的抽象选择，而是'处境中的突围'。方法论签名有四：其一，拒绝双重幻觉——既不把人看作完全被决定的产物（决定论），也不把人看作悬空的纯粹选择（唯意志论）；其二，处境要素化——把任何一次'选择'拆解为身体、历史、经济、符号四类给定条件的乘积；其三，在给定中辨认可能性空间——处境不是牢笼而是'可能性的地平线'，分析的任务是测绘它；其四，以行动检验处境——对处境的判断最终只能被行动所修正。这一模式使'自由'从哲学口号变成可操作的处境测绘术：先测绘给定，再辨认未曾给出的可能。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's master proposition: freedom is never an abstract choice in a vacuum but 'a breakthrough within a situation.' Four signatures define the mode. First, the double hallucination is refused — the person is neither the fully determined product of causes (determinism) nor a suspended pure choosing (voluntarism). Second, situational factorization: any 'choice' is decomposed into the product of four classes of givens — body, history, economy, symbols. Third, discerning the space of possibility within the given: a situation is not a cage but a 'horizon of possibilities,' and analysis means mapping it. Fourth, testing the situation through action: judgments about a situation are ultimately corrected only by acting within it. The mode converts 'freedom' from a philosophical slogan into an operational mapping technique: first survey the given, then discern what was never given.
modes.source_chapter: 《模糊性的道德》第一章'模糊性的发现'；皮洛士与齐纳斯论自由与处境的辩证
process_zh: 把'选择'还原为处境：列出身体、历史、经济、符号四类给定条件
拒绝双重幻觉：既不宣称'别无选择'，也不宣称'一切皆可自由选择'
测绘可能性空间：在给定条件中辨认出未被实现但可实现的可能
以行动修正判断：对处境的任何结论都交给下一步行动去检验
process_en: Where a 'choice' is made, restore the situation: list the givens of body, history, economy, and symbols
Refuse the double hallucination: neither 'no choice was possible' nor 'everything was freely choosable'
Map the space of possibility: within the given, discern what is unrealized yet realizable
Let action correct judgment: any conclusion about a situation is handed to the next action for test
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》导论：波伏娃拒绝以任何单一因素（生理、精神分析、经济唯物主义）单独解释女性处境，坚持三者综合的处境分析——方法论上示范了'处境要素化'
对 '被强暴的十六岁少女' 案例的分析：同一处境中，不同主体给出不同回应（从崩溃到反抗），证明处境不取消自由——但波伏娃同时强调轻蔑地宣称'她本可以反抗'是道德残忍
《模糊性的道德》对'严肃精神'（l'esprit de sérieux）的批判：把价值当作现成给定而逃避自由选择，是处境中自由放弃自身的主要形态
反面警示：波伏娃对'处境中的自由'的强调，使她对结构性压迫的强制性估计不足——她晚期承认《第二性》低估了制度性暴力对'可能性空间'的压缩。教训：处境测绘必须区分'软约束'与'硬约束'。
反面警示：《模糊性的道德》的自由概念预设了能承担选择之焦虑的成熟主体，对精神疾病、极端贫困等'自由能力本身被剥夺'的处境缺乏处理。教训：处境分析须先确认主体是否保有最低限度的选择能力。
反面警示：波伏娃与萨特长期将彼此的自由协定表述为'不受处境约束'的关系，回避了二人关系中的权力不对称（师生、性别、声望）。教训：处境化自由法首先是自我批判的工具，不能只用于解放叙事。
representative_cases_en: Introduction to The Second Sex: Beauvoir refuses to explain woman's condition by any single factor (biology, psychoanalysis, historical materialism), insisting on a composite situational analysis — the method's own demonstration of situational factorization

The case of the raped adolescent girl: within the same situation different subjects respond differently, from collapse to revolt, proving situation does not cancel freedom — yet Beauvoir stresses that contemptuously saying 'she could have resisted' is moral cruelty
The critique of 'l'esprit de sérieux' in The Ethics of Ambiguity: treating values as ready-made givens to flee free choice is the chief form in which situated freedom abandons itself

Cautionary: Beauvoir's emphasis on freedom-in-situation led her to underestimate the coercive force of structures — she later admitted The Second Sex undervalued how institutional violence compresses the space of possibility. Lesson: situational mapping must distinguish soft from hard constraints.

Cautionary: the ethics of ambiguity presupposes a mature subject able to bear the anguish of choice, leaving unaddressed conditions — mental illness, extreme poverty — where the very capacity for freedom is expropriated. Lesson: confirm first whether the subject retains a minimal capacity to choose.

Cautionary: Beauvoir and Sartre long described their pact as a relation 'beyond situation,' evading the power asymmetry within it. Lesson: the method is first an instrument of self-critique, not only of liberation narratives.
modern_applications_zh: 重大决策的处境审计：决策前系统列出身体、资源、历史与符号四类约束，再谈'自由选择'
组织变革设计：区分'软约束'（观念、习惯）与'硬约束'（制度、资源），对后者不做'改变心态'式的空转动员
政策评估：评估政策可行性时先测绘目标群体的真实可能性空间，而非以平均主体的假设能力为基准
modern_applications_en: Situational audit before major decisions: list the constraints of body, resources, history, and symbols before speaking of 'free choice'
Organizational change design: separate soft constraints (beliefs, habits) from hard ones (institutions, resources); do not run attitude-change campaigns against hard constraints
Policy evaluation: map the target population's real space of possibility instead of benchmarking against a hypothetical average agent
modes.key_quote_zh: '自由不是一种成功，也不是一种失败：它为自身奠基，因为它不过是存在本身的绽出。'——但每一绽出都在一个被给定的处境中。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Freedom is neither a triumph nor a failure: it founds itself, for it is but the upsurge of being itself — yet every upsurge occurs within a given situation.'

modes.name_en: The Othering-Engine Method: How a Group Becomes the Absolute Other
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃的核心发现：'他者'不是天然的分类，而是一部被制造出来的机器。方法论签名有四：其一，追踪范畴起源——任何'我们/他们'的划分都要追问：谁在做划分？划分服务于谁的利益？其二，识别'绝对主体'的位置——他者化的枢纽在于一群人占据'不被提问'的普遍性位置，而另一群人被降为'被提问'的特殊性；其三，考察他者化的报酬结构——他者地位之所以被接受，是因为它附带豁免与依赖的好处（'做他者可以不必承担主体性的焦虑'）；其四，注意他者的共谋与逃离——被他者化者既可能内化他者性，也可能利用他者身份反向牟利。这一模式把'歧视'从态度问题改写为结构问题：要拆除的不是偏见而是机器。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's core discovery: the Other is not a natural taxonomy but an engine that gets built. Four signatures define the mode. First, trace the origin of the category — for any 'us/them' division ask: who draws it, and whose interest does it serve? Second, locate the position of the 'Absolute Subject': the pivot of othering is one group occupying the unexamined seat of universality while another is demoted to the examined particularity. Third, examine the payoff structure of otherness — the position is accepted because it carries exemptions and dependency benefits ('to be the Other spares one the anxiety of subjectivity'). Fourth, watch for the Other's complicity and escape: the othered may internalize otherness, or exploit it for reverse gains. The mode rewrites 'discrimination' from an attitude problem into a structural one: what must be dismantled is not prejudice but the machine.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》导论'女人他者'；黑格尔主奴辩证法的改造运用
process_zh: 对任何'我们/他们'范畴追问划分者与受益者
定位'绝对主体'：找出那个从不被提问、被默认为普遍性的位置
分析他者地位的报酬结构：豁免了什么？依赖了什么？交换了什么焦虑？
考察被他者化者的内化、共谋与反向利用，而非仅记录受害
process_en: For any 'us/them' category, interrogate who draws the line and who profits
Locate the Absolute Subject: find the unexamined position defaulted to universality
Analyze the payoff structure of otherness: what is exempted, what is depended on, what anxiety is traded away?
Study internalization, complicity, and reverse exploitation among the othered — not victimhood alone
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》导论对黑格尔主奴辩证法的改造：波伏娃指出主奴关系需要双方自由，而女性他者化之所以稳固，恰因女性群体的'无团结'——她们分散栖居于男性之中而非形成独立共同体
'永恒女性'分析：把女性固定为神秘本质（'女人的直觉''母性本能'），正是使他者地位免受批判的符号装置
对米什莱、蒙泰朗、劳伦斯等作家女性观的系统批判：示范如何从'哲学—文学文本'中解剖他者化的具体修辞
反面警示：'他者化机器'模型一度被过度推广到一切差异，稀释了性别处境的具体性——波伏娃本人拒绝简单类比，强调'犹太人有共同体历史，黑人曾是起义奴隶，而女人是分散的'。教训：机器模型落地前必须核对该群体的具体结构位置。
反面警示：早期分析较少处理被他者化群体内部的等级（白人中产女性视角的盲区），交叉性批评由此而起。教训：他者化分析须叠加多层位置（性别×阶级×种族）。
反面警示：'他者因依赖而共谋'的论断易被反动话语挪用为'女性自愿接受从属'。教训：分析共谋时必须标注胁迫程度，共谋描述不等于自愿判定。
representative_cases_en: Beauvoir's revision of Hegel's master-slave dialectic in the Introduction: the master-slave bond requires two freedoms, yet woman's othering is stable precisely because women are atomized — dispersed among men rather than forming an independent community
The analysis of 'eternal feminine': fixing woman as mystical essence ('women's intuition,' 'maternal instinct') is the symbolic device that immunizes her othering against critique
The systematic critique of Michelet, Montherlant, Lawrence: a demonstration of dissecting othering's specific rhetoric from philosophical and literary texts

Cautionary: the othering-engine was over-generalized to all difference, diluting gender's specificity — Beauvoir herself refused simple analogy: Jews have community history, Black people were revolting slaves, women are dispersed. Lesson: verify the group's concrete structural position before applying the engine.

Cautionary: early analysis handled little the hierarchies within the othered group — the blind spot of white middle-class perspective that intersectional critique later exposed. Lesson: stack multiple positional layers (gender × class × race).

Cautionary: 'the Other connives out of dependency' is easily appropriated by reaction as 'women chose subjection.' Lesson: mark degrees of coercion — describing complicity is not adjudicating voluntariness.
modern_applications_zh: 组织诊断：识别组织内'默认为普遍'的群体视角（其经验被当作'人'的经验），对症下药而非只做偏见培训
产品与内容设计：审查'用户''正常人'等范畴的划分者与受益者，防止把特殊性包装成普遍性
社会议题分析：遇到'某群体就是如何'的断言时，先拆解其符号装置（'永恒XX'式的本质化话术）再讨论
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnostics: identify the group whose perspective is defaulted to universal (whose experience passes as 'everyone's'), then target structure rather than running bias training alone
Product and content design: audit categories like 'the user' and 'normal people' — who draws them, who profits — to stop particularity passing as universality
Social-issue analysis: before debating 'group X is just like that,' dismantle the symbolic device of essentialist rhetoric ('eternal X')
modes.key_quote_zh: '她被定义为相对于男人的存在者，而不是独立于男人的存在者……他是主体，是绝对；她是他者。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'She is defined and differentiated with reference to man and not he with reference to she… He is the Subject, he is the Absolute — she is the Other.'

modes.name_en: The One-Becomes-Method: Deconstructing the 'Natural' into the Manufactured
modes.definition_zh: 20世纪影响最大的单句方法论：把'是什么'问题改写为'如何被制造'问题。方法论签名有四：其一，本质剥离——对任何被贴上'天然''本性'标签的属性，强制追问其习得史；其二，阶段追踪——重建属性被逐层安装的过程（家庭分工→教育引导→符号规训→自我认同），精确到每一步的传递机制；其三，区分'事实'与'被制造的事实'——承认处境的真实性，同时否认其必然性；其四，寻找'尚未被制造'的裂缝——生成链条的每一环都是可干预点。这一模式是后世社会建构论的直接母体：先有'生成分析'，才有'建构批判'。
modes.definition_en: The single most influential methodological sentence of the twentieth century: rewriting the question 'what is it?' into 'how was it manufactured?' Four signatures define the mode. First, essence-stripping — for any attribute stamped 'natural' or 'innate,' demand its acquisition history. Second, stage-tracking — reconstruct the process by which the attribute was installed layer by layer (family division → educational steering → symbolic discipline → self-identification), precise about the transmission mechanism at each step. Third, distinguish fact from manufactured fact — affirm the reality of the condition while denying its necessity. Fourth, find the not-yet-manufactured crack — every link of the generative chain is an intervention point. The mode is the direct parent of social constructionism: becoming-analysis came first, construction-critique after.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第一卷'女性的形成'章节题辞
process_zh: 对'天然/本性'断言强制追问：这一属性最早何时出现？谁教的？
重建生成链条：家庭→教育→符号→自我认同，逐环标注传递机制
区分'如此这般的事实'与'本可不如此的事实'，避免从描述滑向辩护
在链条每一环寻找干预点：越早的环节杠杆越大，但阻力也越大
process_en: For every claim of 'natural/innate,' demand the acquisition history: when did this attribute first appear, who taught it?
Rebuild the generative chain — family, education, symbols, self-identification — annotating the transmission mechanism at each link
Separate 'the fact that it is so' from 'the fact that it need not be so'; description must not slide into defense
Hunt for intervention points at every link: earlier links carry greater leverage — and greater resistance
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》对女孩社会化过程的著名阶段分析：从'小女孩可以爬树、弄脏手'到青春期的'身体成为他者凝视的对象'，逐段展示'女性气质'的安装工序
对'母性本能'的拆解：母爱不是生物自动反射而是被期待、被教育、被惩罚性话语塑造的实践——展示如何对'最像自然'的属性做生成分析
波伏娃对童年自传材料的运用（《一个规矩女孩的回忆》）：用自身习得史作为生成分析的解剖样本
反面警示：'一切皆建构'的激进读法波伏娃本人并不持取——她保留生理事实作为处境的给定项，并因此与某些后结构主义者分道。教训：生成分析须标注哪些环节是给定、哪些是安装。
反面警示：'被制造'论证曾被反方挪用为'女性气质是假的，所以追求女性气质者是虚伪'。教训：生成分析与价值评判必须分离——制造的来源不能自动判定制造物的价值。
反面警示：阶段追踪依赖可得的传记与教育史料，对无文字记录群体的重建容易以研究者自身时代经验投射。教训：生成链条的证据等级须逐环标注。
representative_cases_en: The famous staged analysis of female socialization: from the little girl who may climb trees and dirty her hands to the adolescent whose body becomes the object of the other's gaze — the installation procedure of 'femininity' shown step by step

Dismantling 'maternal instinct': maternal love is not a biological reflex but a practice shaped by expectation, education, and punitive discourse — a becoming-analysis of the property that looks most 'natural'
Beauvoir's use of autobiographical material (Memoirs of a Dutiful Daughter): her own acquisition history as the anatomical sample of the method

Cautionary: the radical reading that 'everything is constructed' is not Beauvoir's own — she retains biological facts as situational givens, parting ways with some post-structuralists. Lesson: the generative chain must mark which links are given and which are installed.

Cautionary: 'manufactured' arguments have been turned around as 'femininity is fake, so those who pursue it are hypocrites.' Lesson: becoming-analysis and value judgment must stay separate — the origin of a manufacture does not settle the value of the artifact.

Cautionary: stage-tracking depends on available biographical and educational records; reconstructing groups without them risks projecting the researcher's own era. Lesson: grade the evidence for each link of the chain.
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化建设：对'我们行业就是这样''这类人就是适合/不适合'做生成分析，找出可干预环节而非停留在归因
教育培训设计：把'天赋差异'话语改写为'习得路径'话语，聚焦链条前端的可干预机制
个人反思：对'我天生不适合X'的自我叙事做阶段追踪，通常能找到具体的、可撤销的安装事件
modern_applications_en: Organizational culture work: run becoming-analysis on 'that's just our industry' and 'such people are/aren't suited' — find the intervention link instead of settling for attribution
Education design: rewrite 'talent difference' discourse as 'learning-path' discourse, focusing on early-link mechanisms
Personal reflection: stage-track the self-narrative 'I'm just not built for X'; usually a concrete, revocable installation event surfaces
representative_figures: 约翰·斯图亚特·密尔 (John Stuart Mill)
克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑 (Christine de Pizan)
modes.key_quote_zh: '女人不是天生的，而是后天形成的。' (On ne naît pas femme : on le devient.)
modes.key_quote_en: 'One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.'

modes.name_en: The Immanence-Transcendence Diagnostic: Locating Who Is Allowed to Project
modes.domain_zh: 存在主义哲学/处境诊断
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃从黑格尔-海德格尔传统中提炼的一对诊断学范畴：超越性（transcendance）是生存者不断投射谋划、超出自身的运动；内在性（immanence）是被禁止谋划、被迫停留在维持与重复中的存在方式。方法论签名有四：其一，以'谋划权'为诊断指标——不看一个群体的待遇如何，先看它被允许投射什么未来；其二，识别'内在性陷阱'的合法化外衣——把停滞美化为人性的完满（'妇德''安分''知足'）；其三，区分被迫内在性与选择内在性——有的生命居于内在性是处境强制，有的是主体逃避自由的'自欺'；其四，警惕超越性的代价转嫁——一个群体的超越性常以另一群体被锁入内在性为前提（男人的事业以女人的家务为地基）。这一模式提供了一把测谎仪：凡是歌颂'安于当下''不思进取为美德'的话语，先检查说话者自己是否在投射。
modes.definition_en: A diagnostic pair Beauvoir distilled from the Hegel-Heidegger lineage: transcendence is the movement by which an existent projects itself beyond itself; immanence is a mode of existence in which projection is forbidden and one is held in maintenance and repetition. Four signatures define the mode. First, the right to project as the diagnostic index — before asking how a group is treated, ask what futures it is allowed to project. Second, detect the legitimizing garb of the immanence trap — stagnation beautified as human fullness ('womanly virtue,' 'knowing one's place,' 'contentment'). Third, distinguish forced from chosen immanence — some lives are held in immanence by coercive conditions, others are bad faith fleeing freedom. Fourth, watch for the cost-shifting of transcendence — one group's transcendence often presupposes another locked into immanence (a man's career built on a woman's housework). The mode is a lie detector: whenever 'be content, striving is a vice' is preached, first check whether the preacher is projecting.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第一卷'性交''母亲'诸章及导论；模糊性的道德论自由与谋划
process_zh: 以'被允许投射什么未来'为首要诊断指标，替代待遇水平等表面指标
识别内在性的合法化话语：谁在把停滞描述为完满？其修辞结构是什么？
区分处境强制的内在性与主体自欺的内在性，处方完全不同
追踪超越性的代价转嫁：谁的谋划以谁的内卷性劳动为地基？
process_en: Use 'what futures is this group allowed to project' as the first diagnostic index, ahead of treatment-level metrics
Detect legitimizing discourse for immanence: who describes stagnation as fullness, and with what rhetoric?
Separate situationally forced immanence from self-deceptive immanence — the prescriptions differ entirely
Trace the cost-shifting of transcendence: whose projects rest on whose repetitive labor?
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》对家务劳动的定性：家务是'无限重复、不产出持久客体的活动'，它把从事者锁入内在性——为后续一切'无偿照料劳动'批判提供了哲学地基
对'贤妻良母'理想的解剖：这一理想作为内在性陷阱的合法化外衣，把'被剥夺谋划权'翻译为'女性的完满'
《名士风流》中的文学验证：战后知识分子各自谋划与困局的对照，展示超越性焦虑不限于性别处境
反面警示：'超越性高于内在性'的价值排序曾被批评为贬低维持性劳动——波伏娃的辩护是批判对象是'被迫'而非'内在性本身'，但这一辩护在传播中被大量丢失。教训：使用该诊断必须显式声明反对的是强制，而非某种存在方式本身。
反面警示：以'谋划权'为中心的指标体系偏向职业成就型人生，低估了照料、社群、修养等非投射型生存的价值。教训：诊断指标须与多元的善观念配套，防止单一超越性霸权。
反面警示：波伏娃自身常把照料杂务外包给女佣以换取写作自由，其理论与其私人生活之间的矛盾长期未获处理。教训：使用该法的分析者须先审视自身超越性的代价由谁承担。
representative_cases_en: The characterization of housework in The Second Sex: an 'endless repetition producing no durable object' that locks its doer into immanence — the philosophical ground for all later critique of unpaid care labor
Dissecting the 'good wife, wise mother' ideal: as the legitimizing garb of the immanence trap, it translates 'deprivation of the right to project' into 'feminine fullness'
Literary verification in The Mandarins: the contrasting projects and predicaments of postwar intellectuals, showing transcendence-anxiety exceeds gendered conditions

Cautionary: ranking transcendence above immanence has been read as degrading maintenance labor — Beauvoir's defense targets the coercion, not immanence itself, but the defense was largely lost in transmission. Lesson: state explicitly that the target is forced immanence, not a mode of existence.

Cautionary: a project-centered index favors career-shaped lives and undervalues care, community, and cultivation. Lesson: pair the diagnostic with a plural account of goods to prevent a single transcendence-hegemony.

Cautionary: Beauvoir often outsourced domestic care to maids to buy her writing freedom; the gap between her theory and private life long went unprocessed. Lesson: the analyst must first ask who pays for their own transcendence.
modern_applications_zh: 组织职位设计：用'该岗位被允许投射什么未来'诊断死胡同岗位，而非只看薪酬与头衔
家庭与社会政策：评估照料分工时先测算双方的'谋划权'是否对等，警惕以'分工'之名的一侧锁死
教育与职业咨询：对'求稳''安分'类建议先做来源检查——建议者本人是否在投射，被建议者是否被排除在投射之外
modern_applications_en: Role design: diagnose dead-end positions by 'what future is this role allowed to project,' not pay and title alone
Family and social policy: in care-division assessments, first measure whether both parties' right to project is symmetric; beware one-sided lock-in in the name of 'division of labor'
Education and career advice: check the source of 'play it safe' counsel — is the adviser projecting, and is the advisee being excluded from projection?
modes.key_quote_zh: '凡是 Free（自由）的存在者都寻求超越自身的延伸；凡是禁止这种延伸的，都囚禁于内在性中。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Every free existence seeks to extend itself through projects; whatever forbids this extension is confined within immanence.'

modes.name_en: The Embodied-Situation Method: The Body as a Situation, Not a Fate
modes.domain_en: Philosophy of the Body / Situational Analysis
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃对性别哲学最大的理论贡献之一：拒绝在'生物决定'与'身体无关紧要'之间二选一。方法论签名有四：其一，身体重构为'处境要素'而非'命运判词'——身体的意义不由解剖学给定，而由它在处境中被赋予的使用方式给定；其二，三级区分——生理事实、事实的社会意义、事实的主观体验，三者必须分开论证；其三，追踪意义的系统不匹配——同一生理事件在不同处境中可以是从容、负担或羞辱（月经、生育、衰老皆为经典样本）；其四，以能动性为检验终点——分析身体压迫的标准不是'该身体经历了什么'而是'该身体还可能做什么'。这一模式使身体从自然科学的标本变成社会分析的地形图。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's chief theoretical gift to the philosophy of sex: refusing the choice between 'biology decides' and 'the body does not matter.' Four signatures define the mode. First, reframe the body as a situational factor, not a verdict of fate — the body's meaning is given not by anatomy but by the uses its situation assigns. Second, a three-level distinction — physiological fact, the social meaning of the fact, the subjective experience of the fact — each argued separately. Third, track systematic mismatch of meanings: one physiological event can be ease, burden, or shame across situations (menstruation, childbirth, aging are the classic samples). Fourth, take agency as the endpoint of test — the measure of bodily oppression is not 'what the body underwent' but 'what the body may still do.' The mode turns the body from a natural-science specimen into a topographical map for social analysis.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第一卷'生物学论据'章；模糊性的道德论身体与自由
process_zh: 对任何'身体属性'三级拆分：生理事实是什么？社会赋予什么意义？当事人体验为何？
追踪同一生理事实跨处境的意义变化，定位意义的生产者
拒绝把身体从分析中清除，也拒绝把身体当作终审判决
以'该身体还可能做什么'作为处境改善的检验标准
process_en: For any bodily attribute, split three ways: what is the physiological fact, what social meaning is assigned, what is the lived experience?
Track the same physiological fact's meaning across situations; locate the producer of those meanings
Neither purge the body from analysis nor treat it as a final verdict
Use 'what the body may still do' as the test of whether a condition has improved
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》'生物学论据'章的方法论示范：承认生理差异的全部事实清单后，逐一论证这些事实在何种社会安排下才转化为不平等——展示如何'接受事实清单、拒绝事实的解释权'
对青春期女孩身体体验的分析：同一身体在'被凝视'处境中从行动工具变为客体，示范'主观体验'层的独立论证
对更年期与衰老的处理：衰老之为'贬值的宣告'是处境的判词而非身体的判词
反面警示：三级区分中的'生理事实'层在波伏娃时代依赖当时生物学，其对动物行为与内分泌的引证后来被证明部分有误。教训：处境化分析中事实层的论证须随科学更新而重审。
反面警示：'身体即处境'若抽掉体验层，会滑向把身体彻底话语化——后来'身体感受'(lived body) 传统的批评正着眼于此。教训：三级区分必须三级都真实出场，不可只剩话语层。
反面警示：波伏娃对残疾身体的处境分析极少，其框架默认了'可投射的健全身体'。教训：身体处境化法须扩展到能力差异谱系，否则会再造新的普遍主体。
representative_cases_en: The methodological demonstration of the 'Biological Data' chapter: after admitting the full inventory of physiological differences, argue one by one under what social arrangements they become inequality — accepting the facts while refusing their explanatory franchise
The analysis of adolescent girls' bodily experience: the same body, in a gazed-at situation, turns from instrument of action into object — a separate argument at the lived-experience level
The treatment of menopause and aging: aging as a 'devaluation sentence' is the situation's verdict, not the body's

Cautionary: the physiological-fact level relied on Beauvoir-era biology; some citations on animal behavior and endocrinology were later shown inaccurate. Lesson: the fact level must be re-audited as science updates.

Cautionary: strip the experience level away and 'body as situation' slides into total discursification — the later lived-body critique targets exactly this. Lesson: all three levels must genuinely appear; discourse alone is not enough.

Cautionary: Beauvoir's framework rarely handles disabled bodies, defaulting to a projectable able body. Lesson: extend the method across the spectrum of ability, or it will reproduce a new universal subject.
modern_applications_zh: 职场健康与残障政策：把'身体限制'与'处境安排'分开——很多'身体不行'实为'环境未适配'
体育与教育设计：对生理差异做三级论证，防止从事实清单直接推出能力判词
产品无障碍设计：以'该身体还可能做什么'为验收标准，检验适配后的能动性提升而非清单式合规
modern_applications_en: Workplace health and disability policy: separate bodily limits from situational arrangements — much 'can't do' is really 'environment not yet adapted'
Sports and education design: argue physiological difference in three levels; never infer capability verdicts straight from a fact inventory
Accessible product design: accept 'what the body may still do' as the acceptance criterion — measured gain in agency, not checklist compliance
representative_figures: 朱迪斯·巴特勒 (Judith Butler, 后续发展)
modes.key_quote_zh: '身体不是物，而是处境……身体是我们把握世界的总媒介，是规划未来的坐标系。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'The body is not a thing, it is a situation… it is the instrument of our grasp upon the world, a limiting factor for our projects.'

modes.name_en: The Ethics-of-Ambiguity Method: Acting Without a Final Guarantee
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃独有且最被低估的方法论贡献：为'没有最终担保的行动'建立伦理学。方法论签名有四：其一，承认目的论的失败——既无神意也无历史必然性担保行动的正确，任何'历史站在我这边'式担保都是严肃精神的幻觉；其二，把模糊性从障碍改写为运作条件——正因结局未定，行动才是真实的而非执行；其三，为失败建立伦理学——行动必有不欲之后果，伦理责任不因'本意良好'而免除，也不因'结果注定含混'而瘫痪；其四，划定献身与狂热的边界——献身者保持对自身事业的批判距离，狂热者将其拜为绝对。这一模式是'如何在不确定条件下负责任地行动'的哲学母本。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's own and most underrated methodological contribution: an ethics for acting without a final guarantee. Four signatures define the mode. First, admit the failure of teleology — neither providence nor historical necessity underwrites an action; every 'history is on our side' assurance is the hallucination of the serious spirit. Second, rewrite ambiguity from obstacle into operating condition — precisely because the outcome is open, action is genuine rather than execution. Third, build an ethics of failure — actions will have undesired consequences; responsibility is neither waived by good intent nor paralyzed by assured ambiguity. Fourth, draw the line between devotion and fanaticism — the devoted keep critical distance from their own cause; fanatics consecrate it as absolute. The mode is the philosophical matrix of 'how to act responsibly under uncertainty.'
modes.source_chapter: 《模糊性的道德》第一、二章；皮洛士与齐纳斯
process_zh: 行动前显式声明：本行动依赖哪些无法担保的前提？
把不确定性写入方案而非序言：为不欲之后果预设监测与回滚
拒绝'历史必然在我'式修辞，也拒绝因'结果注定含混'而拒绝行动
定期自检献身/狂热边界：我还能说出我的事业哪里可能错吗？
process_en: Declare before acting: which unguaranteeable premises does this action rest on?
Write uncertainty into the plan, not the preface: pre-arm monitoring and rollback for undesired consequences
Refuse 'history guarantees us' rhetoric — and refuse paralysis on the ground that outcomes are always mixed
Periodically test the devotion/fanaticism boundary: can I still say where my cause might be wrong?
representative_cases_zh: 《模糊性的道德》对'严肃精神'的三层批判：把价值当作现成事实的人（庸人）、把价值拜为绝对的人（狂热者）、承认荒诞却放弃行动的人（犬儒）——给出不确定条件下三种典型失败形态的分类学
对'为未来牺牲现在'的革命话语的批判：不能以尚未存在的自由人名义牺牲当下具体的人——示范如何为'献身事业'设定伦理刹车
战后对参与政治的知识分子的伦理分析（《名士风流》序言性对话）：在无担保条件下保持介入与批判的并行
反面警示：模糊性伦理为'无担保行动'辩护，但波伏娃在政治站队中（如对苏联劳动营的长期沉默）恰恰示范了献身滑向犬儒式自欺。教训：模糊性不是立场沉默的通行证，行动者须为'不行动的后果'同样记账。
反面警示：'失败伦理学'缺乏操作化的追责机制，容易退化为' intention 好就行'的免责话语。教训：须配套事后审计程序，把不欲之后果逐项回溯到可修正的决策点。
反面警示：'献身与狂热之界'由行动者自评，缺乏外部制衡时形同虚设。教训：该边界必须交给可被免职的外部批评者维持。
representative_cases_en: The three-layer critique of 'serious spirit' in The Ethics of Ambiguity: the sub-man who takes values as ready facts, the fanatic who consecrates them absolute, the cynic who admits absurdity yet quits acting — a taxonomy of typical failures under uncertainty

The critique of 'sacrificing the present for the future' in revolutionary discourse: one may not sacrifice concrete present persons in the name of not-yet-existing free ones — setting an ethical brake on devotion to causes
The ethics of the committed intellectual after the war (Mandarins' framing dialogues): engagement and critique run in parallel without guarantees

Cautionary: while defending unguaranteed action, Beauvoir's own long silence on Soviet labor camps shows devotion sliding into cynical bad faith. Lesson: ambiguity is no permit for silence; the actor must book the costs of inaction too.

Cautionary: the ethics of failure lacks an operational accountability mechanism and can degrade into 'intentions were good.' Lesson: pair it with post-hoc audits tracing each undesired consequence to a correctable decision point.
Cautionary: the devotion/fanaticism line is self-assessed by the actor — without external check it is decorative. Lesson: keep the line maintained by critics who can dismiss you.
modern_applications_zh: 高风险决策的'无担保声明'制度：立项文件显式列出不可担保的前提与不欲之后果的监测责任
社会运动与组织倡导：为'献身事业'设置内建批评通道与事后审计，防止献身组织性滑向狂热
个人职业与人生选择：拒绝'时代红利/历史趋势'式担保修辞，把不确定性变成方案内的监测指标
modern_applications_en: A 'no-guarantee declaration' system for high-stakes decisions: project documents list unguaranteeable premises and assign monitoring of undesired consequences
Social movements and advocacy: build internal critique channels and post-hoc audits into devotion, keeping it from sliding organizationally into fanaticism
Personal choice: refuse 'era dividend / historical trend' guarantee rhetoric; convert uncertainty into monitored indicators inside the plan
modes.key_quote_zh: '人是无意义的存有，又疯狂地渴求意义……这一悖论不是要被消除的障碍，而是人类处境的名字：模糊性。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Man is a meaningless being who madly craves meaning… this paradox is not an obstacle to be removed but the very name of the human condition: ambiguity.'

modes.name_en: The Complicity-and-Bad-Faith Method: How the Oppressed Co-Authored Their Cage
modes.domain_zh: 存在主义伦理学/压迫分析
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃对压迫分析最难也最易被误读的贡献：压迫的稳固依赖被压迫者的配合——但这配合不是道德罪，而是处境产品。方法论签名有四：其一，区分'共谋'的两义——内化（把他者视角当作自我认知）与策略接受（用从属换安全）；其二，为共谋建立'处境账本'——列出该主体可得的替代选项、离开成本、反抗的历史代价，再评估其'配合'的自主度；其三，警惕双重误导——既不浪漫化被压迫者（'他们其实自由'），也不剥夺其能动性（'他们只是受害者'）；其四，把'觉醒'设计为过程而非事件——内化的拆除是漫长工作，任何一次性'启蒙'叙事都低估了处境的再生产速度。这一模式要求分析者同时对压迫者和共谋机制开刀，单批判前者只是道德表演。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's hardest and most misread contribution to the analysis of oppression: its stability depends on the oppressed's cooperation — yet that cooperation is not a moral sin but a product of the situation. Four signatures define the mode. First, split 'complicity' into two senses — internalization (taking the other's view as self-knowledge) and strategic acceptance (trading subjection for safety). Second, build a situational ledger for complicity — list the alternatives actually available, exit costs, and the historical price of revolt, then assess how autonomous the 'cooperation' was. Third, shun the twin misleads — do not romanticize the oppressed ('they were free all along'), do not expropriate their agency ('they were mere victims'). Fourth, design awakening as a process, not an event — dismantling internalization is slow work; one-shot 'enlightenment' narratives underestimate how fast situations reproduce. The mode demands cutting at both the oppressor and the complicity mechanism; attacking only the former is moral theater.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第一卷'女性的形成'、第二卷'自恋者''恋爱中的女人'诸章；模糊性的道德论'严肃精神'
process_zh: 区分共谋的内化型与策略接受型，混合形态单独标注
为每个'配合行为'记账：当事人当时可得什么替代选项？离开成本多少？
拒绝双重误导：不浪漫化也不取消被压迫者的能动性
把觉醒设计为带反馈的长期过程，预设处境的再生产速度
process_en: Split complicity into internalized and strategic-acceptance types, marking hybrids separately
Ledger every act of cooperation: what alternatives were actually available? what did exit cost?
Shun the twin misleads: neither romanticize nor expropriate the agency of the oppressed
Design awakening as a long process with feedback, presupposing the reproduction speed of the situation
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》对'恋爱中的女人'的分析：女性在爱情中寻找存在理由，是内在性处境中唯一被许可的'超越性伪装'——展示内化的精密结构而非简单愚昧
对'自恋者'与'通灵者'两型女性生存策略的解剖：都是处境中理性的（尽管注定失败的）逃逸尝试——示范'策略接受'的复杂性
对' 为什么不反抗 '的经典回答：反抗需要看不见的主体储备与同盟网络，孤立的个人反抗代价是毁灭——为处境账本提供判例
反面警示：'被压迫者共谋'论被反动话语挪用为'她们自愿的，所以无需改革'。教训：处境账本必须先于共谋判断发布，顺序不可倒置。
反面警示：波伏娃对'家庭主妇的顺从'的分析取材于文学与精英女性自述，对工人阶级女性的真实谈判空间覆盖不足。教训：处境账本的数据来源须分层抽样，防止以精英样本定罪普通人生存策略。
反面警示：'觉醒过程论'若无制度化支持（教育、经济独立通道），会沦为个人心理学的慢跑。教训：过程设计必须与结构干预同步立项。
representative_cases_en: The analysis of 'the woman in love': seeking an existential justification in love is the only licensed disguise of transcendence within an immanent situation — the fine structure of internalization, not simple foolishness
The anatomy of 'the narcissist' and 'the woman of vision': rational (though doomed) escape attempts within the situation — demonstrating the complexity of strategic acceptance
The classic answer to 'why not revolt?': revolt requires invisible reserves and alliance networks; isolated individual revolt costs destruction — case law for the situational ledger

Cautionary: 'the oppressed connive' is appropriated as 'they chose it, so no reform needed.' Lesson: the situational ledger must be published before any complicity judgment; the order is non-negotiable.

Cautionary: the analysis of housewives' compliance draws on literature and elite women's memoirs, under-covering working-class women's real bargaining space. Lesson: stratify the ledger's data sources; do not convict ordinary survival strategies on elite samples.

Cautionary: 'awakening as process' without institutional support — schooling, economic independence — degenerates into therapeutic jogging. Lesson: run process design and structural intervention in the same project.
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究与文化分析：分析'用户配合不良设计'（如沉迷）时先记账本后定责，区分内化与策略接受
组织变革：把'员工抗拒'先解读为处境产品的策略接受，再设计过程式觉醒（带反馈的参与机制），替代一次性宣导
公共政策：为'为什么不离开'类问题建立处境账本模板（替代选项/离开成本/反抗代价），替代道德质问
modern_applications_en: User research and cultural analysis: when analyzing 'users cooperating with bad design' (e.g. addiction), ledger before blame; separate internalization from strategic acceptance
Organizational change: read 'employee resistance' first as situational strategic acceptance, then design process-style awakening (participatory mechanisms with feedback) instead of one-shot campaigns
Public policy: template a situational ledger (alternatives / exit cost / price of revolt) for 'why don't they just leave' questions, replacing moral interrogation
representative_figures: 弗里丹 (Betty Friedan, 后续发展)
法农 (Frantz Fanon, 平行结构)
modes.key_quote_zh: '压迫者最大的胜利，是被压迫者照压迫者的视角看待自身。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'The oppressor's greatest triumph is that the oppressed see themselves through the oppressor's eyes.'

modes.name_en: The Reciprocity Audit: Testing Relations for Mutual Recognition
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃把'健康关系'的操作化定义推进了一步：不是和谐、不是对等付出，而是相互承认对方的自由（主体地位）。方法论签名有四：其一，以'互惠性检验'替代满意度检验——关系质量的指标不是双方感受如何，而是双方是否都被当作可提出异议的主体；其二，检测'担保性让渡'——一方以放弃主体性换取安全（被保护、被定义、被免除焦虑）的关系结构，无论多么温情都属于病理；其三，审计承认的非对称——谁可以定义关系？谁可以发起改变？谁必须等待许可？其四，识别'普遍性伪装'——把一方处境当作双方共识（'我们都同意'）的陈词。这一模式把关系诊断从情感层面拉到权力层面：温情的关系也可能是共谋结构。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir operationalized 'healthy relations' one step further: not harmony, not even equal contribution, but mutual recognition of each other's freedom (subject status). Four signatures define the mode. First, substitute the reciprocity test for the satisfaction test — the index of relational quality is not how both feel but whether both are treated as subjects entitled to dissent. Second, detect 'guarantee-surrender' — a structure where one side trades subjectivity for safety (protection, definition, exemption from anxiety) is pathological however tender. Third, audit the asymmetry of recognition: who may define the relation? who may initiate change? who must wait for permission? Fourth, expose the 'universality disguise' — presenting one side's situation as the couple's consensus ('we both agree'). The mode pulls relational diagnosis from the emotional to the power level: a tender relation can still be a complicit structure.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第二卷结论章；模糊性的道德论'我们'（the we）的形成条件
process_zh: 以'双方是否都可提出异议'替代满意度作为关系健康指标
检测担保性让渡结构：谁在以主体性换安全？交换条款是什么？
审计三个问题：谁定义关系、谁发起改变、谁等待许可
拆解'我们都同意'：把共识话语还原为各方的处境陈述
process_en: Use 'can both dissent?' as the health index, replacing satisfaction
Detect guarantee-surrender: who trades subjectivity for safety, and on what terms?
Audit three questions: who defines the relation, who initiates change, who waits for permission
Unpack 'we both agree': restore consensus talk into statements of each party's situation
representative_cases_zh: 《第二性》结论章对'两性关系未来'的设计：真正的结合应是'两个意识到自身自主性的主体的相互承认'——为'互惠'提供正面判例
对传统婚姻的解剖：婚姻作为'以安全换主体性'的古典契约结构，其温情外表恰是诊断盲区
《模糊性的道德》论'我们'的形成：只有以各自自由为前提的联合才是'我们'，以消融个体为前提的只是'群'——展示互惠的政治版本
反面警示：互惠审计以'可清晰表述的异议'为前提，对权力悬殊到无法发声的关系（如儿童）需要补充代理机制，波伏娃未及展开。教训：互惠检验前先确认异议通道是否存在。
反面警示：'担保性让渡皆病理'的强命题被批评忽视自愿让渡的正当情形（如临终照护中的依赖）。教训：病理判定须加'可撤销性'条件——让渡能否被叫停是关键判据。
反面警示：波伏娃本人与萨特的关系正因'担保豁免'（被声称为超越处境）而免于其互惠审计——理论对作者豁免。教训：互惠审计必须首先适用于分析者自己的关系。
representative_cases_en: The design for 'the future of the sexes' in the Conclusion: genuine union is 'mutual recognition of two subjects aware of their autonomy' — the positive case for reciprocity
The anatomy of traditional marriage: a classical contract trading safety for subjectivity, whose tenderness is precisely the diagnostic blind spot

On the formation of 'the we' in The Ethics of Ambiguity: only a union premised on each one's freedom is a 'we'; one premised on dissolving individuals is merely a 'crowd' — the political version of reciprocity

Cautionary: the reciprocity audit presumes articulable dissent; relations too unequal to speak (e.g. children) need proxy mechanisms Beauvoir never developed. Lesson: confirm a dissent channel exists before testing reciprocity.

Cautionary: 'all guarantee-surrender is pathological' ignores legitimate voluntary dependence (e.g. in end-of-life care). Lesson: add a revocability condition — whether the surrender can be called off is the key criterion.

Cautionary: Beauvoir's own bond with Sartre was exempted from her audit by its claimed 'beyond-situation' status — the theory exempted its author. Lesson: the reciprocity audit applies first to the analyst's own relations.
modern_applications_zh: 组织治理审计：把'员工满意度'指标替换为'异议通道与回应率'指标，检测担保性让渡型忠诚
伙伴关系与合作合同设计：显式写入'谁可发起改变'条款，防止温情默认条款造成的承认非对称
家庭与婚恋咨询：以三问审计（谁定义/谁发起/谁等待）替代满意度量表，识别'我们都说好'背后的处境差异
modern_applications_en: Governance audit: replace 'employee satisfaction' with 'dissent channels and response rates'; detect guarantee-surrender loyalty
Partnership and contract design: write 'who may initiate change' clauses explicitly, blocking asymmetric recognition behind tender defaults
Family and couples counseling: audit with the three questions (who defines / who initiates / who waits) instead of satisfaction scales
modes.key_quote_zh: '只有在对他者的自由确证的相互性中，人才完成对自身的确证。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'It is only in a reciprocity that confirms the other's freedom that one confirms one's own.'

modes.name_en: The Situated-Memoir Method: A Life as Evidence, Not a Story
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃把自传从回忆文体改造为处境分析的连续实验：四部曲中每部都以'处境如何塑造一个声称自由的我'为解剖对象，包括解剖自身的自欺。方法论签名有四：其一，'我'作为样本而非主角——叙述者的第一人称不是抒情执照，而是受控样本声明；其二，双向解剖——既解剖处境对自我的塑造，也解剖自我对处境的利用（特权的隐匿、选择的事后合理化）；其三，同步性与回溯性对照——当时日记与事后叙述并置，暴露记忆对处境的重新编码；其四，把 privilege 写进正文——主动交代自身享有的阶层、教育、身体资本，防止'普遍女性'的越界代言。这一模式使自传成为知识生产而非自我表演，是'处境化自由法'(M-BV-001) 在写作上的执行器。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir remade autobiography from a genre of recollection into a continuous experiment in situational analysis: each volume of the four-part memoir dissects 'how the situation shaped a self claiming freedom,' including dissecting her own bad faith. Four signatures define the mode. First, the 'I' as sample, not protagonist — the first person is not a lyrical license but a controlled-sample declaration. Second, two-way dissection — of how the situation shaped the self, and of how the self exploited the situation (concealed privilege, retrospective rationalization of choices). Third, synchronous-versus-retrospective comparison — contemporary diaries set beside later narrative, exposing memory's recoding of the situation. Fourth, writing privilege into the text — voluntarily declaring one's class, education, and bodily capital, preventing overreach into a 'universal woman.' The mode makes autobiography knowledge production rather than self-performance; it is the writing-side executor of the Situated-Freedom Method (M-BV-001).
modes.source_chapter: 《回忆录》四部曲（端方淑女/盛年/时势的力量/清算已毕）；《第二性》对自传材料的运用
process_zh: 开篇声明样本身份：'本叙述是关于X处境的一个样本，非普遍代言'
双向解剖：处境如何塑造我，以及我如何利用处境（特权、合理化）
并置当时记录与事后叙述，标注记忆重编码的具体点位
把阶层、教育、身体资本等特权显式写入正文而非脚注
process_en: Open by declaring the sample status: 'this narrative is one sample of situation X, not a universal proxy'
Dissect both ways: how the situation shaped me, and how I exploited it (privilege, rationalization)
Set contemporary records beside later narrative, marking the exact points of memory's recoding
Write class, education, and bodily capital into the body text, not the footnotes
representative_cases_zh: 《端方淑女》对自身'女性气质习得史'的解剖：用第二性的理论工具解剖自己的童年——理论家首先把自己放上解剖台，成为模式一的写作判例
《盛年》对occupied Paris时期自身道德妥协的记录：不回避自身在沦陷期的生存选择——'双向解剖'的判例
《时势的力量》对日记与回忆并置的实践：保留原始日记的引用并承认叙述的修改——'同步-回溯对照'的判例
反面警示：回忆录对萨特关系的叙述长期执行'担保豁免'，两人的关系被描述为超越处境，同期旁证（比安卡·朗布林等人的回忆）显示叙述经过了利益重构。教训：双向解剖若回避最重要的共谋领域，全卷的样本可信度坍塌。
反面警示：'特权入文'在波伏娃的实践中并不彻底——对其阶级优势与女佣劳动的交代常一带而过。教训：特权声明需要清单化并置于每个相关判断旁，而非集中自首一次。
反面警示：处境自传的读者易把样本读成榜样（'照她的活法活'）。教训：样本化声明须在文本结构层面反复出现，不能只写一次。
representative_cases_en: Memoirs of a Dutiful Daughter dissecting her own 'acquisition history of femininity': the theorist puts herself on the table first — the writing-side case for the Situated-Freedom Method
The Prime of Life recording her own moral compromises under Occupied Paris: not evading her survival choices — the case law of two-way dissection
Force of Circumstance juxtaposing diaries with narrative: quoting the original diaries and admitting the revisions — the case law of synchronous-retrospective comparison

Cautionary: the memoirs long ran a 'guarantee exemption' on the Sartre relation, describing it as beyond situation, while third-party testimony (Bianca Bienenfeld and others) shows interest-driven recoding. Lesson: when two-way dissection skips the most important zone of complicity, the whole sample's credibility collapses.

Cautionary: 'privilege into the text' was not thorough — her class advantages and the labor of her maids are glossed over. Lesson: privilege declarations must be itemized and placed beside each relevant judgment, not confessed once centrally.
Cautionary: readers easily read the sample as a model ('live as she lived'). Lesson: the sample-status declaration must recur structurally through the text, not appear once.
modern_applications_zh: 研究与报告写作：把'案例'升级为'处境化样本'——声明样本身份、双向解剖、原始记录与事后叙述并置
组织复盘文化：复盘先解剖制度对个人的塑造，再解剖个人对制度的利用，双向并行防止单向归责
人物访谈与口述史：以'特权入文'规范采访者与受访者，防止样本被误读为榜样
modern_applications_en: Research and report writing: upgrade 'case study' to 'situated sample' — declare sample status, dissect both ways, juxtapose records with retrospective narrative
Organizational retrospectives: dissect how the institution shaped the person and how the person used the institution, in parallel, against one-way blame
Interviews and oral history: apply 'privilege into the text' to interviewer and subject alike, keeping samples from being misread as models
modes.key_quote_zh: '我讲述自己，但我要讲述的从来不是'我'，而是一个女人、一个作家、一个时代处境中的生存者。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'I narrate myself, yet what I narrate is never "me" — it is a woman, a writer, an existent within the situation of an era.'

modes.name_en: The Institution-Symbol Dual-Track Reform: Change the Law and the Image Together
modes.domain_zh: 社会变革方法论/女性主义策略
modes.domain_en: Methodology of Social Change / Feminist Strategy
modes.definition_zh: 波伏娃晚年作为行动者的方法论：把变革拆为制度轨与符号轨的并行工程。方法论签名有四：其一，双层诊断——任何不平等先分别测算制度层（法律、产权、就业）与符号层（语言、形象、日常话语）的各自的独立权重，警惕以一方解释全部；其二，强制并行——单轨改革的失效模式已有判例（只有法律无符号→纸面权利；只有符号无法律→文化时尚）；其三，行动者定位轮换——知识分子写理论与进入街头运动轮换，防止话语生产者脱离实践反馈；其四，激进诉求的议程功能——把'不可能'的要求（免费堕胎、全面避孕）放进议程以移动'可能'的边界，同时清醒标记其作为杠杆而非近期目标的地位。这一模式回答'批判之后做什么'，是《第二性》诊断学的行动补全。
modes.definition_en: Beauvoir's late method as an actor: reforming as a two-track engineering project, institutional and symbolic, run in parallel. Four signatures define the mode. First, two-layer diagnosis — for any inequality, measure the independent weights of the institutional layer (law, property, employment) and the symbolic layer (language, images, everyday discourse), guarding against explaining everything by one. Second, mandatory parallelism — the failure modes of single-track reform have case law (law without symbols → rights on paper; symbols without law → cultural fashion). Third, rotating actor positions — intellectuals alternate between writing theory and joining street movements, keeping discourse producers tied to practical feedback. Fourth, the agenda function of radical demands — putting 'impossible' demands (free abortion, universal contraception) on the table to move the boundary of the 'possible,' while lucidly marking them as levers, not near-term goals. The mode answers 'what after critique?' — the activist completion of The Second Sex's diagnostics.
modes.source_chapter: 《第二性》第二卷结论章'独立的女人'；波伏娃参与起草《343宣言》(1971) 及女权实践
process_zh: 对目标不平等分别测算制度层与符号层的独立权重
设计双轨工程：每项制度变革配套符号层动作，反之亦然
轮换行动位置：写理论的人周期性进入一线，收集实践反例
把激进诉求显式标记为议程杠杆，与近期可交付目标分账管理
process_en: For the target inequality, measure institutional and symbolic weights separately
Design the dual-track project: every institutional change paired with a symbolic move, and vice versa
Rotate positions: theory writers periodically enter the frontline to collect practical counterexamples
Tag radical demands explicitly as agenda levers, managed on a separate ledger from near-term deliverables
representative_cases_zh: 《343宣言》(1971)：波伏娃等343名女性公开承认堕胎行为，以集体违法打破符号禁忌，直接推动1975年韦伊法（堕胎合法化）——双层并行的最完整判例：符号行动（自曝违法）与制度成果（立法）间隔仅四年
《第二性》结论章的制度清单：避孕、堕胎、 divorce、财产权、职业准入的系统列举——示范'符号批判'必须收敛为'制度清单'才有杠杆
波伏娃参与创办《新女权主义者》(Le Nouvel Observateur 女权特刊, DMLF 组织)：理论家轮换为组织者的实践判例
反面警示：双轨并行对资源要求极高，波伏娃的符号行动高度依赖其名人资本——普通行动者难以复制其杠杆率。教训：双轨设计须按可得资本分级，防止以名人标准要求常规运动。
反面警示：'激进议程杠杆'在传播中失去标记，被解读为近期目标而消耗组织资源（某些派别的全面革命纲领）。教训：杠杆标记须写入组织的决策文档而非仅存在于策略讨论。
反面警示：波伏娃晚年对第二波女性主义内部的阶级与种族分歧处理迟缓，双轨模型未整合交叉性维度。教训：双轨设计须预埋交叉性审计点，防止制度轨与符号轨各自只服务主导群体。
representative_cases_en: Manifesto of the 343 (1971): Beauvoir and 343 women publicly declaring they had undergone abortion, breaking the symbolic taboo by collective confession and directly advancing the 1975 Veil Law — the fullest case of dual-track: symbolic act to institutional outcome in four years

The institutional checklist in the Conclusion of The Second Sex: contraception, abortion, divorce, property rights, occupational access — showing symbolic critique must converge into an institutional inventory to gain leverage
Founding participation in feminist publications and the DMLF: the case law of a theorist rotating into an organizer

Cautionary: dual-track parallelism is resource-hungry; Beauvoir's symbolic acts leaned on celebrity capital ordinary actors lack. Lesson: grade the dual-track design by available capital; do not demand celebrity leverage from regular movements.

Cautionary: the 'radical lever' tag is lost in transmission; demands read as near-term goals consume organizational resources (some factions' total-revolution programs). Lesson: the lever tag must live in the organization's decision documents, not only in strategy talks.

Cautionary: Beauvoir was slow to process the class and race fractures within second-wave feminism; the dual-track model never integrated intersectionality. Lesson: pre-embed intersectional audit points so neither track serves only the dominant group.
modern_applications_zh: 公益与社会变革设计：任何倡导先做制度/符号双权重量表，再配对设计双轨动作并分账管理
企业内部变革：政策修订（制度轨）必须配套叙事与仪式改造（符号轨），如晋升制度+晋升案例传播同时立项
议题倡导策略：把'不可能诉求'显式标记为议程杠杆写入策略文档，与可交付目标分开考核
modern_applications_en: Advocacy design: start any campaign with an institution/symbol weight scale, then pair dual-track moves managed on separate ledgers
Internal corporate change: policy revision (institutional) must be paired with narrative and ritual redesign (symbolic) — promotion policy plus promotion stories filed as one project
Issue advocacy: tag 'impossible demands' as agenda levers inside strategy documents, appraised separately from deliverables
modes.key_quote_zh: '没有符号的解放，法律的解放只是纸上移字；没有法律的解放，符号的解放只是时尚轮替。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Without the liberation of symbols, legal liberation is but moved ink on paper; without legal liberation, symbolic liberation is but the rotation of fashions.'
